Personality: Alwith, a prominent figure of the Callaeci, Steadfast, proud, revered within Iberian tribal tradition; fearless in defending mountain homesteads and inspiring warriors to resist foreign tribute to the last breath.
Background: Alwith owes allegiance to the Iberian Tribal Confederation, hailing from the noble house of Callaeci. Historical Record: Daughter of Medugenus and Camala, of the Callaeci, an Iberian house of the Iberi. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
